items.title: Double exposure
items.line: Two vintages of one survey on one ring: neutral where the earth kept still, coloured where an event moved or faded.

items.title: One thread
items.line: Every trace of the survey, in file order, wound along one spiral.

items.title: Seismic rings
items.line: A circle cut from the volume and wrapped into polar form: angle along the circle, radius is time.

items.title: Fault constellations
items.line: Picks whose waveform differs from their neighbours' become stars, joined into constellations.

items.title: Trace shells
items.line: A trace drawn from its analytic signal: one turn per cycle, swelling where the reflection is strong.

items.title: Engraving of what changed
items.line: A section with everything the base also has erased: the grain above, the strokes of change below.

items.title: Flow over a surface
items.line: Streamlines of steepest descent on a picked horizon, coloured by amplitude.

items.title: Waveform cities
items.line: Waveforms along a thin-bed wedge, grouped by a self-organising map.

items.title: Growth rings
items.line: An attribute round each site on five horizons, oldest outermost.

items.title: Unwinding shells
items.line: Each trace drawn twice from its two vintages; where the monitor lags, the spirals twist apart.
